title: How Hunter Isaacson built NGL: Instagram-graph virality, one-flow funnels, and scaling with UGC tests
summary: Hunter Isaacson walks through NGL's rise from six months of zero traction to 150M MAU, plus his earlier apps, Bags, and tactical advice on borrowing existing networks' distribution, selling users before tutorials, cheap regional weekly pricing, and spending a $20K/month budget on many small creative tests.

principles.text: Build on top of existing networks: swap the distribution mechanism of a proven behavior and improve the product.
principles.quote: find existing things that happen on other networks or other distribution mechanisms and just switch the distribution mechanism and improve the product to a certain degree

principles.text: Pick the biggest distribution graph; NGL beat predecessors by riding Instagram's link feature.
principles.quote: the reason NGL went as big as it did and has more downloads than all of those apps is because we use the biggest distribution graph of all which is the Instagram graph.

principles.text: Sell the end result in the call to action, not the app download.
principles.quote: it's way easier to get a download by saying get your own messages than saying, hey, download this app.

principles.text: Keep one flow, one funnel, and a single north-star metric; don't overcomplicate after going viral.
principles.quote: just how do you make it like one flow, one funnel, and don't over complicate it and just focus on like a northstar metric.

principles.text: Price weekly subscriptions as low-impulse buys scaled by regional GDP per capita; monetize a small share of a huge free user base.
principles.quote: It's priced differently depending on the region and depending on the GDP per capita of that country. So, it's always like a low impulse buy.

principles.text: With a ~$20K/month budget, run many small creative tests instead of betting on one, and pair them with an invite loop.
principles.quote: Don't spend all the money on like, you know, one specific creative. I would just test like a dozen of them.
